verdict.rationale: MotherDuck describes itself as a serverless data warehouse built on DuckDB with a SQL IDE, and a community user praising Instant SQL's 'CTE inspection' implies CTE support. Nothing in the pack documents the rest of the analytical SQL surface the story asks for. missing for 10: documented window functions, semi-structured JSON support, array/list types, rich date/time types, confirmation these work without extensions, independent hands-on corroboration.
